name: ghira-asr-vi-0.6b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-03. A finetune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.6 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-10-11. CAVEAT: the repo publishes a q8_0 GGUF for NeMo-Speech.cpp only, no bf16 NeMo checkpoint, so these are Q8 numbers and the card does not ablate quantisation cost. Vietnamese rows use syllable WER and ViMedCSS uses a mixed error rate, so they are not directly comparable to plain word-error numbers on other Vietnamese systems. The model does lose one row: FLEURS-en live 11.3 vs base 10.6. English replay was retained at 186 hours, so the English rows are not a zero-shot transfer claim. The weights are the mean of two fine-tunes of the same base, and unlabeled VietMed audio was pseudo-labelled by an earlier version of this model then filtered by Whisper large-v3-turbo agreement, so part of the training set is model-generated.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS-vi WER, long (lower better)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results' table (WER %, lower better), column 'This model' 11.1 vs column 'Base' 12.2 in the same table. 'Long' = 3-6 min files of joined clips, stream reset after each Vietnamese line. Syllable WER for Vietnamese. Test splits never trained on.

benchmarks.name: ViMedCSS WER, long (lower better)
benchmarks.config: Same table; 16.8 vs base 18.6. Medical code-switch set, mixed error rate. Test videos overlapping train were dropped.

benchmarks.name: VietMed WER, long (lower better)
benchmarks.config: Same table; 13.3 vs base 14.7. Medical conversation.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS-vi WER, live (lower better)

benchmarks.name: FLEURS-en WER, per clip (lower better)
